{"code": "import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re

# URL of the Wikipedia candidate discussion page
url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_article_candidates/Giganotosaurus/archive1"

# Fetch the page content
response = requests.get(url)
print(f"Status code: {response.status_code}")

# Parse the HTML
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')

# Let's first examine the structure of the page
print("\n=== Page Structure Overview ===")
print(f"Title: {soup.title.text}")

# Look for common patterns in nomination discussions
# Nominations are typically in the first section after the header
# Let's find the main content area
main_content = soup.find('div', {'id': 'mw-content-text'})
if main_content:
    print("Found main content area")
    
    # Look for sections or paragraphs that might contain nomination text
    # In Wikipedia FAC pages, nominations often start with specific patterns
    paragraphs = main_content.find_all(['p', 'div', 'span'])
    
    nomination_text = None
    nominator = None
    
    # Common patterns for nominations
    nomination_patterns = [
        r"^I nominate",
        r"^Nominat",
        r"^This article",
        r"^Giganotosaurus",
        r"^FA nomination",
        r"^Featured article nomination"
    ]
    
    print("\n=== Searching for Nomination Text ===")
    for elem in paragraphs:
        text = elem.get_text().strip()
        if text and len(text) > 50:  # Reasonable length for nomination
            for pattern in nomination_patterns:
                if re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE):
                    print(f"Found potential nomination text (pattern: {pattern}):")
                    print(f"First 200 chars: {text[:200]}...")
                    nomination_text = text
                    
                    # Try to extract username - common patterns in Wikipedia
                    # Usernames are often linked and appear at the beginning
                    user_link = elem.find('a', href=lambda x: x and '/User:' in x)
                    if user_link:
                        nominator = user_link.text
                        print(f"Found nominator via user link: {nominator}")
                    
                    # Also look for signature patterns (~~~~ or --~~~~)
                    signature_pattern = r'\[\[User:(.+?)\|'
                    signature_match = re.search(signature_pattern, str(elem))
                    if signature_match:
                        nominator = signature_match.group(1)
                        print(f"Found nominator via signature pattern: {nominator}")
                    
                    break
    
    # If we didn't find it with patterns, try another approach
    if not nomination_text:
        print("\n=== Trying Alternative Approach ===")
        # Look for the first substantial content after the table of contents
        all_text = main_content.get_text()
        lines = all_text.split('\n')
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            line = line.strip()
            if line and len(line) > 100:  # Substantial content
                if 'nominate' in line.lower() or 'nominat' in line.lower():
                    nomination_text = line
                    print(f"Found via keyword search: {line[:200]}...")
                    
                    # Search for username in the surrounding context
                    context = ' '.join(lines[max(0, i-3):min(len(lines), i+3)])
                    user_match = re.search(r'\[\[User:(.+?)[\|\]\s]', context)
                    if user_match:
                        nominator = user_match.group(1)
                        print(f"Found nominator in context: {nominator}")
                    break
    
    print("\n=== Final Results ===")
    if nomination_text:
        print(f"Nomination text found: {nomination_text[:300]}...")
    else:
        print("No nomination text found")
    
    if nominator:
        print(f"Nominator username: {nominator}")
    else:
        print("Nominator username not found")
else:
    print("Could not find main content area")"}
